title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Eternal: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Hey everybody! I'm doing it!"
A royal pain in the Fire Nation's backside.
Thanks to Katara, the coal meant to fuel enemy ships instead fueled the prisoners' liberation.
"I've seen that girl in here quite a lot. Seems to me she has quite a little crush on you." —Iroh, to Zuko
Koala-sheep can fall asleep anywhere, and often do.
"You think my name is funny?"
Sokka mastered the sword like his friends mastered the elements.
"The first thing you must learn is that your weapon is an extension of yourself. You must think of it as another part of your own body." —Master Piandao
Rain filled Appa's pawprint, and despair filled Momo's heart.
"My first girlfriend turned into the moon." —Sokka
Though Sokka believed the toucan-puffins were gathering intel for the enemy, it's far more likely they were simply gathering nesting for their mates.
Wan Shi Tong rewards those who provide rare and insightful tomes.
Capable of both blasting ships to pieces and humbling showboating Avatars.
Airbenders employ negative jing in combat, preferring to blow their opponents back instead of fighting.
The Dai Li are the cultural authority of Ba Sing Se and guardians of all Earth Kingdom traditions.
Large carcasses lead to large flies. Large flies lead to large problems.
"Azula, we are concerned for you and your well-being."
"If the Fire Nation thinks they can invade my home, it'll be the last mistake they ever make."
Zuko's scar reminded him of the day he refused to fight his father, and the brutal lessons that followed.
A predator once abundant in the dunes of ages past, now most commonly found as pets napping in the shady areas of the Misty Palms Oasis.
"Enemies and traitors, all working together..." —Azula
Generations of war created lost children in every nation, with no loyalty to anyone but each other.
He rarely used words, but then again, he rarely needed them.
Moku marches to the beat of a different drum.
"I have changed."
Despite a lack of funds, the elderly zookeeper tried his very best to care for his animals.
"The secret ingredient is love." —Iroh
"I knew a bison whistle would come in handy." —Aang
"My cabbages..."
Against Toph, an army's greatest mistake is touching the ground.
Jennamite, also known as "creeping crystal," grows remarkably fast. It's also a delicious candy.
The Crystal Catacombs offered Aang sharp and enduring armor, making him a fair match against an opponent as sharp and enduring as Azula.
Like the Avatar that is their namesake, the Kyoshi Warriors fight with dedication, strategy, and ferocity.
"First you form a ball. Then you've got to get on quick!"
Versatile swords for a complicated swordsman.
"It's not about strength. Our technique is about using your opponent's force against them." —Suki
"My name is Zuko. Prince of the Fire Nation and heir to the throne."
Once Aang and The Blue Spirit were under attack, it was unclear which one was rescuing the other.
"Clouds are made of water and air, so between the two of us, we ought to be able to bend them into any shape we want." —Aang
"Excellent! Using your superior agility against an older opponent." —Master Piandao
"I'm going to join the Avatar. And I'm going to help him defeat you."
"Now I get it. Something awful happened on that day. I don't know what, but I do know why. Firebenders lose their bending during a solar eclipse!" —Sokka
"Earth Nation! Fire Nation! Water Nation! So long as bargains are your inclination, you're welcome here!" —Pirate peddler
"Hmm. Delectable tea, or deadly poison?" —Iroh
"I beat you all before and I'll do it again!" —Toph
In the skies of the Si Wong Desert, a solitary winged lemur searched in vain for a lost friend.
Brave soldier boy comes marching home.
"I want to make a deal. It's time that I regain control of Ba Sing Se, and you have something I need." —Long Feng
Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.
By studying the ways of the Waterbenders, Iroh learned how to redirect lightning.
"I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you'd lost your way." —Iroh
Zuko's rage fueled his firebending, making him one of the fiercest in the Fire Nation.
The wisdom of many in one so small.
"Sozin's comet is arriving and our destinies are upon us!"
"No! My cabbages!"
Buried beneath the sands of an unforgiving desert, a vast library of knowledge stores mysterious books in its massive halls.
"Gotta be quicker next time."
"My ancient cake-making technique isn't the only thing on your mind, is it, Aang?"
"The silk thread symbolizes the brave blood that flows through our veins. The gold insignia represents the honor of the warrior's heart."
To the Avatar, was the Blue Spirit a friend? A foe? Or something else entirely?
"The strength of your heart makes you who you are."
"Our strength comes from the spirit of the moon; our life comes from the spirit of the ocean. They work together to keep balance." —Princess Yue
paragraphs.card: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

paragraphs.text: "Make sense of our past, Aang, and you will bring peace, and restore balance to the world."
"Yes, we defeated you for all time. You will never rise from the ashes of your shame and humiliation!"
Aang learned the hard way not to play with fire.
"As long as I'm confident with who I am, it doesn't matter what other people think."
"You are clearly outnumbered," barked the soldier. "You are clearly outmatched," Iroh replied.
"It's about time we did something fun together."
Jet's Freedom Fighters are a dangerous band whose strength lies in three things: their purpose, their numbers, and their bond.
A sky bison is a companion for life.
"Calm down. It's going to be okay."
Kyoshi Warrior drills are designed to encourage individual discipline as well as uncompromising trust in their fellow warriors.
"Where's Momo?" —A common query among Team Avatar
Otter-penguins often play with humans, carrying them on their backs as they sled down snowy embankments.
"It's important that you show no fear when you face a Firebender."
Wolf Cove's snow fort doubles as Sokka's watchtower and a playground for Water Tribe children.
Life is simply slower in the snow. Nobody knows that better than the villagers of Wolf Cove.
Her judgment was swift and final... and rather rude.
Schools of dolphin-fish follow Fire Nation vessels, hoping to score an easy meal from broken nets.
A place of infinite wonders and endless perils.
"I think I just figured out why they call it the Serpent's Pass!" —Sokka
Their underwater ice caves weave throughout the north pole, providing traversal for those willing to brave the cold.
"The key is getting the wrist movement right."
"The rats that scurried across the floor of my cage were nothing more than skins filled with liquid." —Hama
"Hey! That kid's the Avatar!"
"The Fire Nation shall be victorious by any means necessary."
For any creature to survive in the Si Wong Desert, they must be hardworking, extremely opportunistic, or both.
Fire Nation circuses captivate audiences with even more captive animals.
Useful for whipping up a fictional plague in a pinch.
Fire Nation guards rely more on fear than fire.
"Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame."
"You wish to speak to Avatar Roku. I can take you to him."
Though Avatar Roku mastered all four elements, nothing seemed to quell a brewing conflict like a sun-sized ball of fire.
"For the glory of the Fire Nation!"
"Once I deliver the Avatar to my father, he will welcome me home with honor and restore my rightful place on the throne."
"Nothing runs faster over land or swims quicker than a giant eel-hound." —Master Piandao
Some of the mysterious croaking and chittering heard in the Foggy Swamp can be traced back to frog-squirrels, who hop along the canopy and snack on giant insects.
While hippo-cows are relatively docile, wise farmers still prefer to keep a safe distance.
"Here's your chance, Earthbenders! Take it! Your fate is in your own hands!" —Katara
"The key is being completely rooted—physically and mentally unmovable."
Nothing's wilder than a hog-monkey.
Buzzard-wasps single-mindedly scour the Si Wong Desert in search of dead or dying prey.
Sky bison know no boundaries by land or sea, for the sky above them is boundless.
Makapu Village was a highly desirable place to live and farm. Though the local fortune teller claimed the volcano was dormant, the Avatar thought otherwise.
With the Avatar's aid, the Ba Sing Se Zoo became a safe haven for animals across the four nations.
Outside the sanctuary of Ba Sing Se's walls, humble Earth Kingdom villages hope to stave off the news of war for just one more day.
"Ember Island gives everyone a clean slate. Ember Island reveals the true you." —Lo and Li
"In the Swamp, we see visions of people we've lost, people we've loved, folks we think are gone." —Нuu
Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.
"I guess you've never fought an Airbender before." —Aang
Even Firebenders hate fire ants, so the Sun Warriors ensure the sloths are free to eat their fill.
"Where's Моmo?" —A common query among Team Avatar
"You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving you will come to a better place."
"There's someone in there! He's bending the vines!" —Sokka
Noble passengers require noble transportation.
"You're not to blow the dam until I give the signal." —Jet
Fire Nation soldiers spread like wildfire during the Hundred Year War.
"Come out, Avatar! You can't hide from me forever." —Zuko
The Komodo Rhino embodies the spirit of Fire Nation soldiers. They are aggressive, disciplined, and feared.
Even without its rider, a Komodo Rhino will cause its fair share of destruction— unaided and unprompted.
"Stand and fight, Avatar!"
"Looks like I underestimated you." —Zuko
"All the past Avatars, all their experience and wisdom, is available to you if you look deep inside yourself." —Avatar Roku
"The Fire Lord is Aang's fight. We need to stay focused on stopping that fleet from burning down the Earth Kingdom."
"Your technique is useless on me."
"Even the separation of the four elements is an illusion. If you open your mind you will see all the elements are one, four parts of the same whole." —Guru Pathik
"True power is something you're born with."
"I could spend an eternity in here."
"If you let the energy in your own body flow, the lightning will follow it." —Iroh
"Everyone guesses wrong because the dealer moves the rock at the last minute, but I can feel it with my earthbending."
"Toph, there's too many of them. We need an Earthbender. We need you." —Katara
"Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights."
"You chose them from among thousands of toys, Aang. The toys you picked were the four Avatar relics. These items belonged to Avatars past. Your own past lives." —Monk Tashi

"The road ahead of us is challenging. A hundred years of fighting has left the world scarred and divided. But with the Avatar's help, we can get it back on the right path and begin a new era of love and peace." —Zuko
"Air is the element of freedom." —Iroh
